hero.subtitle: Public, private and hybrid cloud: migration, cloud-native hosting, backup and disaster recovery, DevOps and multi-cloud governance.

challenge.title: The challenge in KSA
challenge.body: The government's Cloud First policy and new in-Kingdom cloud regions have accelerated migration. Organizations now need to move the right workloads, keep personal data resident, control spend and avoid creating new security gaps.
points: Choosing what to move, where, and in what order
Data-residency obligations under the PDPL and sector rules
Cloud bills that grow faster than value
Inconsistent security posture across several clouds

opportunity.title: The opportunity
opportunity.body: A planned, governed move to in-Kingdom cloud gives agility and resilience, and creates the platform AI and modern applications need, without losing control of data or cost.

capabilities.title: Public, private and hybrid cloud
capabilities.body: Architecture that matches each workload to the right environment.

capabilities.title: Migration planning and execution
capabilities.body: Assessment, wave planning and low-risk migration.

capabilities.title: Backup, disaster recovery and storage
capabilities.body: Recovery objectives defined, tested and met.

capabilities.title: Multi-cloud governance and security posture
capabilities.body: Policies, guardrails and posture management across every cloud.

applications.title: Data-centre exit
applications.body: Move workloads out of ageing facilities in planned waves.

applications.title: Disaster recovery in-Kingdom
applications.body: Secondary sites and tested recovery for critical systems.

applications.title: Platform for AI workloads
applications.body: GPU-ready, governed environments for enterprise AI.

applications.title: Cost and posture review
applications.body: Find waste and misconfigurations across existing cloud accounts.

vision2030.body: Cloud adoption in line with the Cloud First policy supports a more agile government and a competitive digital economy.

deployment.note: In-Kingdom public cloud regions, private cloud in your data centre, or a governed hybrid of both.
